plan.title: RFQ commercial unlock blocked before technical evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer side.
Navigate to the commercial RFQ stage where the unlock action is available.
Open the stage event settings menu to reach the commercial unlock action.
Start the manual commercial unlock attempt.

args.goal: enter a valid OTP and password in the unlock dialog, submit the Open Commercials attempt, and stop when the screen shows the refusal that bids cannot be unlocked until technical evaluation is done

steps.note: Perform the unlock dialog interaction and capture the buyer-side refusal, which has no dedicated catalog action.
